question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.
sql:
WITH player_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker AS player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_in_match
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE bb.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5)
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id, bb.innings_no
),
player_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(runs_in_match) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches_played,
        AVG(runs_in_match) AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_runs_per_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_balls AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker AS player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    WHERE bb.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5)
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),
player_not_outs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker AS player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bb.match_id || '-' || CAST(bb.innings_no AS VARCHAR)) AS not_outs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    WHERE bb.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5)
      AND bb.innings_no = (
          SELECT MAX(innings_no) FROM ball_by_ball bb2 
          WHERE bb2.match_id = bb.match_id
      )
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),
player_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.player_id,
        ps.total_runs,
        ps.matches_played,
        ps.avg_runs_per_match,
        COALESCE(pballs.balls_faced, 0) AS balls_faced,
        COALESCE(pno.not_outs, 0) AS not_outs,
        CASE WHEN (balls_faced - not_outs) > 0 
             THEN ps.total_runs * 1.0 / (balls_faced - not_outs) 
             ELSE 0 END AS batting_average
    FROM player_summary ps
    LEFT JOIN player_balls pballs ON ps.player_id = pballs.player_id
    LEFT JOIN player_not_outs pno ON ps.player_id = pno.player_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ps.avg_runs_per_match,
    ROUND(ps.batting_average, 2) AS batting_average
FROM player_stats ps
JOIN player p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY ps.avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5
